client.verifiedHint: This site read the app's details from a document the app publishes at its own web address.
client.registeredHint: The app registered itself and chose its own name; nothing has checked it.

content.label: Content
content.read: Read posts, pages, their revisions and content types.
content.write: Write, publish, schedule and trash posts and pages.

media.label: Media
media.write: Upload images and files, edit alt text, trash media.

terms.label: Terms
terms.read: See categories, tags and other terms.

menus.label: Menus
menus.write: Add, remove and reorder menu items.

comments.label: Comments
comments.read: Read comments, including those waiting for moderation.
comments.write: Approve, mark as spam, trash and reply to comments.

users.label: Users
users.write: Nothing more than reading: managing users stays in the admin.

settings.label: Settings
settings.write: Change the site's settings and content types.

extensions.label: Themes and plugins
extensions.read: See the installed themes and plugins and their settings.
extensions.write: Switch themes, turn plugins on or off and change their settings.

import.label: Import
import.read: No assistant tool uses this yet: imports stay in the admin.
import.write: No assistant tool uses this yet: imports stay in the admin.

system.label: System
system.read: See site health, background jobs and the audit log.
system.write: Nothing more than reading: jobs and backups stay in the admin.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.read: Never granted to assistants: webhooks stay in the admin.
webhooks.write: Never granted to assistants: webhooks stay in the admin.

consent.title: Connect {{client}}
consent.description: {{client}} is asking to manage {{site}} for you.
consent.registeredWarning: This app named itself. Approve only if you just started connecting it from your assistant.
consent.permissionsHint: Preselected from what it asked for and your role allows. Write includes reading.
consent.resetHint: Allow what the app asked for
consent.beyondRole_one: It also asked for {{areas}}, which your role does not allow. It will not get it.
consent.beyondRole_other: It also asked for {{areas}}, which your role does not allow. It will not get them.
consent.nothingGrantable: Your role allows none of what this app asked for, so it cannot be connected. Deny the request, or ask an administrator.
consent.actsAsYou: {{client}} acts as you, {{name}}, with your role ({{role}}). It can never do more than you can, and every change it makes is recorded in the audit log under its name.
consent.disconnectAnyTime: You can disconnect it at any time in Account, Connected apps.
consent.failed: That did not work. Try again.

expired.title: This request has expired
expired.body: A connection request lasts ten minutes and works once. Go back to your assistant and start connecting again.

missing.title: No connection request
missing.body: This page is where your AI assistant sends you to approve a connection. Start connecting from the assistant.

approved.title: Connected
approved.body: Returning you to {{client}}. If nothing happens, go back to it; you can close this tab.

denied.title: Not connected
denied.body: {{client}} was not connected. You can close this tab.

redirectRefused.title: We couldn't return you to the app
redirectRefused.body: You can close this tab; the decision was saved.

apps.label: Connected apps
apps.disconnectBody: It loses access to this site at once. To use it again, connect it again from the assistant.
apps.disconnectOther: It loses access to {{user}}'s account on this site at once.
apps.emptyBody: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another assistant, and manage this site by asking.
apps.emptyOther: This user has not connected any AI assistants.
apps.paused: AI assistants are turned off on this site, so connected apps are paused until an administrator turns them back on.
apps.emptyOwn: You have not connected any AI assistants.

settings.enabledHint: When off, the MCP endpoint and the assistants' sign-in answer “not found”. Connected apps are paused, not removed, and work again when you turn this back on.

connect.title: Connect an assistant
connect.description: Paste this address into any assistant that speaks MCP. It asks you to sign in here and approve what it may do; no keys to copy.
connect.off: AI assistants are turned off. Turn them on and save before connecting.
connect.guide: Full guide: every client, permissions and troubleshooting
connect.cloudNote: Claude and ChatGPT connect from their own servers, so this site must be reachable over public HTTPS. A site on localhost works with Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code.

claude.lead: On claude.ai or in Claude Desktop:
claude.body: Add a custom connector (in Claude, under Customize → Connectors), paste the URL, then sign in and approve.

chatgpt.body: In ChatGPT's settings, turn on developer mode and create a connector with this URL and OAuth sign-in.

claudeCode.then: Then run /mcp in Claude Code, choose ferrite and follow the browser sign-in: approve the connection there.
claudeCode.token: Or connect with a personal API token (Account, API tokens) instead of signing in:

cursor.lead: Add the server to Cursor's MCP configuration:
cursor.then: The first time Cursor connects, a browser window opens; sign in and approve.

vscode.lead: Add the server to your workspace's MCP configuration:
vscode.then: The first time VS Code starts the server, a browser window opens; sign in and approve.

can.title: What an assistant can do
can.description: It works through the same rules as the admin: as the person who connected it, with their role, within the permissions they approved.
can.content: Write, edit, publish and schedule posts and pages in Markdown
can.media: Upload images from a link or a file and set alt text
can.structure: Manage terms, menus, content types and redirects
can.site: Change settings, switch themes and configure plugins
can.system: Check site health, background jobs and the audit log

human.title: What stays with people
human.body: No assistant can install or remove plugins or themes, manage users, roles, passwords, tokens or connected apps, run imports, backups or restores, retry jobs, or change this switch.

login.body: Your login: an assistant connects through this site's own sign-in and approval screen.

role.body: Your role: it can do only what you can, in the areas you approve.

audited.body: Audited: every change it makes is in the audit log, under the app's name.

settings.retentionHint: Days, 1 to 365 (default {{value}}). Older change sets are deleted; assistants cannot change this.

dashboard.title: Manage this site with AI
dashboard.description: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to write, publish and tidy up your site. Paste this URL into the assistant to connect it.
dashboard.connectedBody: Your assistants can manage this site as you. Review or disconnect them in Account.
dashboard.offBody: The MCP endpoint is turned off for this site.
dashboard.offPaused: Connected apps are paused until it is turned back on.
dashboard.recent_one: {{count}} change by assistants in the last 24 hours
dashboard.recent_other: {{count}} changes by assistants in the last 24 hours

activity.title: AI activity
activity.description: Everything AI assistants changed on this site over MCP, grouped by connection and session. Review the changes and undo what you do not want.

empty.title: No AI changes yet
empty.body: When an assistant you connected changes something on the site, its changes appear here, ready to review and undo.

activity.tooLarge: Too large to keep: cannot be reverted
activity.hidden: You cannot see this object's contents with your current role.
activity.noDiff: Nothing that a person edits changed.

dialog.will_one: {{count}} change will be reverted, newest first, in one step.
dialog.will_other: {{count}} changes will be reverted, newest first, in one step.
dialog.asYou: Each object goes back through the normal editing paths, as you: your role applies, and content gets a revision you can undo.
dialog.forceHint: The later edits are replaced; for content they stay in the revisions.
dialog.raced: Something changed meanwhile: check the list again.

conflict.later: Changed again later in this set (change {{seq}}): revert that one too
